"""Determinism and no-state-retention test."""
import json, subprocess, sys, random
V1 = json.dumps({"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":1})
V2 = json.dumps({"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":98304})
V3 = json.dumps({"epoch":11,"node_count":3,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":9},{"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":9},{"tail":0,"head":2,"capacity":9}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":9,"paths":[[0,1],[2]],"previous":[0,16]}],"failed_edges":[0],"budget":100})
lines = [V1, V2, V3, V1, V3, V1]
payload = ("\n".join(lines)+"\n").encode()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
out = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("responses:", len(out))
r = {i: out[i] for i in range(len(out))}
same_v1 = (r[0]==r[3]==r[5])
same_v3 = (r[2]==r[4])
print("V1 identical across repeats (incl. after other lines):", same_v1)
print("V3 identical:", same_v3)
if not same_v1:
    print(r[0]); print(r[3]); print(r[5])
if not same_v3:
    print(r[2]); print(r[4])
print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:500])
EOF
